philosophy.title: Philosophy
philosophy.aria_support: Leverages WAI-ARIA to enhance support for assistive technologies.
philosophy.feedback_desc: Provides rapid and natural feedback for user operations, offering a comfortable "tangible" experience.
philosophy.focus_areas: We focus on the following points for design and development:
philosophy.kb_a11y: Supports keyboard operations so all users can use it.
philosophy.standard_overview_desc: For a high-level view of our design and implementation standards, please refer to the Standardization Overview.
philosophy.choice_matrix_desc: Foundation for all WIM UI components and design systems.
philosophy.scenarios_desc: Providing a tangible UI for all applications.
philosophy.tokens_desc: Foundation for all WIM UI components and design systems.
philosophy.responsive_desc: Standard responsive behavior follows the global breakpoint specifications.
philosophy.keyboard_nav_desc: Focus management and keyboard shortcuts across all interactive elements.
philosophy.principles_desc: All design decisions in WIM UI are based on the following five principles.
philosophy.principle_1_desc: All UI elements share a unified visual language through design tokens.
philosophy.principle_2_desc: Assumes WCAG AA compliant contrast ratios and WAI-ARIA patterns.
philosophy.principle_3_desc: Switching between light and dark modes is handled entirely by semantic tokens.
philosophy.principle_4_desc: Supports Japanese, English, and Portuguese, considering the typographic characteristics of each language.
philosophy.principle_5_desc: Provides an optimal experience on both desktop and mobile.

internal.philosophy_desc: Guidelines for internal design consistency and encapsulation that should be followed when extending WIM UI or adding new components.
